description: This file defines the ImmersiveModeFragment class, a Fragment subclass for managing immersive mode (full-screen experience) in an Android application. It handles toggling system UI visibility flags in response to user actions and device configurations.

classes.name: ImmersiveModeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment implementation that manages immersive full-screen mode by toggling UI flags based on user interaction.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and enables options menu.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Sets up a listener to respond to system UI visibility changes and logs the current height of the decor view.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles options menu selection, toggling immersive mode when the specific action is selected.

methods.name: toggleHideyBar
methods.description: Toggles immersive full-screen mode by adjusting UI visibility flags based on Android SDK version.
